name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source online survey platform with a visual survey editor, response management and statistics, backed by MariaDB.

alerts.message: Sign in at /index.php/admin as admin with the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. Changing the ADMIN_* values after the first start has no effect; manage accounts inside LimeSurvey. Email invitations need SMTP settings and a real site administrator email in the global settings.
